notes.title: DEMO-PATCH NOTE 6/16
notes.content:
[p]Thank you very much for playing [b]DRAW WORLD DEMO[/b]!
As of today around 5:00 PM (JST), we’ve made several updates to improve the overall gameplay experience.[/p][p]===============================================[/p][list][*][p]Added a link to the Steam page on the title screen[/p][/*][*][p]Added a function to return to the title screen from the Options menu[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted encounters to prevent running into the same enemy repeatedly[/p][/*][*][p]Modified the card deck editing menu to allow viewing the tutorial at any time[/p][/*][*][p]Made several changes to the mid-to-late game maps[/p][/*][/list][p]===============================================[/p][p]We hope you continue to enjoy [b]DRAW WORLD DEMO[/b], and we appreciate your support for the full version as well![/p]
